title: 有馬記念の後に・憧れの先へ

text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki completes the Arima Kinen, and the stands ring with resonant cheers and applause!
She's overcome with emotion, but she managed to show her audience a beautiful dream. She bows respectfully at them and promises that her miracle will go on.
She's fulfilled her goal of becoming the greatest entertainer ever.
The curtains close on Fuji Kiseki's show, but the end is merely another beginning. The start of her next show will come sooner than we know…
